title: Repair a real coronary gap and build a source-linked CPR review package
question: Given a CTA, a predicted mask, a small review region and named route endpoints, an agent can repair a natural lumen discontinuity while preserving other vessels, trace the intended route and keep rotated CPR and a 3D mesh geometrically consistent.
prior_findings: Broad difficulty is not established. A real 5-mm CAS-Net gap is present despite 94.14% whole-mask Dice, but both fixed author baselines pass, including geometry-only repair and tracing. Terra/high also passes repair, trace and mesh; its single failure is stale CPR arc-length metadata after centerline resampling, resolved by one field correction.
next_action: The bounded larger experiment is complete. Retain the working geometry viewer and frozen software-consistency miss as calibration. Do not promote this as a hard anatomical reasoning failure. Any new discrimination experiment needs independently reviewed natural errors and matched intact/absent/variant controls, with a new freeze rather than tighter post-outcome gates.
